prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate objective function for a GNN-based netlist tier-partitioner (2-tier 3D IC).
Hypothesis of the change: Adding a Laplacian-style penalty sum over net pins of crit_i*crit_j*(p_i-p_j)^2 (critical-pair locality, star-expanded per net) will keep adjacent timing-critical nodes on the same tier, directly attacking the crit-pair cross-tier fraction that the baseline leaves nonzero on C3.
Rule-based digest (scores are improvement ratios vs. the official baseline; C1..C3 are the training circuits by size):
total=+0.065 robust(mean-std)=-0.023 min_case=-0.032 seed_std=0.053 tns_mean=+0.020 all_valid=True
  C1: score=+0.078 dWNS=+10.7% dTNS=+6.6% per-seed=[-0.03 +0.08 +0.19]
  C2: score=+0.019 dWNS=+3.5% dTNS=+1.9% per-seed=[+0.09 +0.01 -0.04]
  C3: score=-0.032 dWNS=-5.5% dTNS=-1.8% per-seed=[-0.02 -0.05 -0.03]
  partition stats vs baseline:
  C1: cut 137->138, wcut 421->406, crit_cross 0.011->0.016, repair_flips 103->121, changed-vs-baseline 15.3%
  C2: cut 318->306, wcut 1007->965, crit_cross 0.000->0.000, repair_flips 238->238, changed-vs-baseline 5.6%
  C3: cut 582->582, wcut 1955->1963, crit_cross 0.069->0.073, repair_flips 353->349, changed-vs-baseline 3.2%
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID, first classify the failure (crash / non-finite loss / balance repair failure / timeout) and whether it is systematic or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which circuit/metric moved and the plausible mechanism (cut nets, critical-pair cross-tier, repair flips)? (3) is the seed spread acceptable? (4) one concrete next step. No preamble.

response:
(1) No. The critical-pair penalty did not reduce crit_cross on C3 (0.069→0.073) and C3 regressed (score −0.032, dWNS −5.5%); C1 crit_cross also rose (0.011→0.016) despite its score gain.

(2) C1 improved via wcut (421→406) but with more repair_flips (103→121) and higher crit_cross—gain likely from cut/weighted-cut, not the penalty. C2 flat (crit_cross already 0). C3 barely changed (3.2% flips) yet worsened, suggesting the penalty perturbed tiers without fixing critical pairs.

(3) No: seed_std 0.053, robust mean −0.023, min −0.032—spread swamps the mean.

(4) Ablate the penalty weight and log crit-pair cross-tier directly per seed on C3 before retuning.
